newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson signs Philippines radio contract.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson signs Philippines radio contract.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Monday it signed a radio access contract in the Philippines with Smart Communications Inc.

Ericsson will supply and install a complete DRA 1900 system and transmission equipment on the Luzon island in the northern part of the Philippines, the group said in a statement without disclosing the order value.
"This is an important contract and a breakthrough for Ericsson in the Philippines," Hans Ekstrom, president of Ericsson's local company in the Philippines, said.
The wireless local loop (WLL) system will be connected to Smart Communication's AXE network, the company said.
"The system is already under development and installations will be completed in the autumn of 1997," the company said.
